notes: Eight own pages read on thefreetms.com, all HTTP 200 and not thin (the brief names thefreetms.com as an AscendTMS address; the canonical ascendtms.com root was not read because the eight-page limit was used on the product site). The partners page shows partner names as logos only, so its text names no partner; the release history page was read instead to settle named integrations (QuickBooks Online, MyCarrierPackets, Highway, Convoy Platform). The pricing page shows monthly prices only ($69, $119, $149 per user); its Yearly toggle carries no prices in the snapshot or the raw HTML, which is why $49 (C04) and $99 Premium (C05) are unverifiable rather than wrong. The free plan (C20) is classed true on the home page line that plans start at zero dollars; the pricing page itself lists only paid plans plus a 30-day trial, and the broker page offers Premium free for up to a year. A hedged line that EDI connections can carry separate charges (q6 ChatGPT runs 1 and 3) and the hedged caution not to assume a permanent free tier (q7 ChatGPT 1) were not coded. Review ratings, feature counts (230+ standard features as a product fact), onboarding times and launch dates were not coded. No claim is wrong or stale, so no cited page was read for causes. For the reviewer only: the press list shows AscendTMS acquired LoadPilot TMS on 20 Feb 2026; no answer states that acquisition. Pass 2 (8 Oct 2026): no browser snapshot exists for AscendTMS. Re-reading the vendor's own release history found two dated Basic Plan entries (Dec 23, 2024: Basic added as a paid tier at $49 per user per month, and no longer limited to 2 users); they bear on C04 and C22 (and C21) but do not date the move to today's $69 or say the 2-user plan was the free plan, so those claims stay unverifiable with the entries noted in their rationales. A reviewer may judge C04 or C22 stale on that evidence. No claim is wrong or stale, so step 3 changed nothing. Completeness: added the q6 Claude run 3 line on free and paid tiers to C20; every other gap line and table cell about AscendTMS was already an instance (Free to $149/user/mo, Free up to 3 users, ~$49/user/month, two Premium seats total $238/month, three seats at $207, $357 or $447, the q7 comparison table cells) or out of scope (best-for lines, ratings, Native EDI and AI cells, the hedged free-tier caution).
